children: Canada oilfield services firm's Q3 revenue rose 24% to record high on strong drilling activity
EPS for Q3 climbed to C$0.23 from C$0.16 a year earlier
Company raised 2026 capital expenditure budget to C$88 mln to expand RSS fleet
PHX Energy raises 2026 capital expenditure budget to $88 mln, up from $80 mln
Company approves preliminary 2027 capital expenditure budget of $75 mln
Company expects strong activity levels to continue into 2027, driven by RSS demand
RECORD RSS ACTIVITY - Co said growth in Rotary Steerable Systems activity, which delivers higher margins, was a key driver of record revenue and earnings
STRONG DRILLING DEMAND - Robust drilling activity in both US and Canada contributed to higher operating days and revenue, per management
INFLATIONARY COST PRESSURES - Co said profitability improvement was limited by inflation and trade-related cost increases, with pricing increases from clients remaining challenging
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas drilling peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for PHX Energy Services Corp is C$15.00, about 18.2% above its November 2 closing price of C$12.69
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
